name: Saint Barthélemy
summary_text: Saint Barthélemy: full French law; small resort island, calm social climate. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.02. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, in French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area and are punished beyond their alleged crimes - relevant to Saint Barthélemy as a French overseas collectivity applying French law.

Opinion of 25 May 2021 by France's Contrôleur général des lieux de privation de liberté (CGLPL) on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty: based on ~40 referrals since 2010, it finds serious violations of fundamental rights persist across places of detention, with recommendations applicable also to intersex and non-binary persons.

sources.title: Transgender rights in Saint Barthélemy — Grokipedia
sources.claim_summary: Grokipedia article on transgender rights in Saint Barthélemy: French national law applies - legal gender-marker change without surgery/sterilization (2016 reform), gender-affirming care available since 1975, anti-discrimination protections extended to gender identity; no non-binary recognition; reported to attract trans migrants from Guadeloupe and Martinique seeking a more accepting environment; healthcare access limited by the territory's small size.

sources.title: Saint Barthélemy LGBTQ+ Travel Guide | Global Gayborhood
sources.claim_summary: Gayborhood destination guide (verified April 2026): St Barth as a discreet luxury destination - 'full French legal protections', a cosmopolitan crowd that 'genuinely doesn't care', no organised gay scene but a completely safe environment for same-sex couples; Traven-Dex safety score 8.6.

Agtra (Against Transphobia) country page for Saint Barthélemy: trans-rights overview scoring 7.7/10 - legal gender change without surgery (per French law, since 2017), judicial process possibly involving medical evaluation, no non-binary recognition, same-sex marriage legal since May 2013, anti-discrimination laws in place, limited local healthcare access; no government LGBT travel advice; no trans-specific community travel advice submitted.

sources.title: Is St. Barths Gay-Friendly? — LGBT tailor-made travel
sources.claim_summary: Out Of Office gay travel agency blog: 'Is St Barths gay friendly?' - travel-agency perspective marketing the island as a welcoming luxury destination for gay couples.
